com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.parsers

类 XMLDocumentParser

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.parsers.XMLParser
      • com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.parsers.AbstractXMLDocumentParser
        • com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.parsers.XMLDocumentParser
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    XMLDocumentHandler, XMLDTDContentModelHandler, XMLDTDHandler

    public class XMLDocumentParser
extends AbstractXMLDocumentParser
    This is a concrete vanilla XML parser class. It uses the abstract parser with either a BasicConfiguration object or the one specified by the application.
    版本:
    $Id: XMLDocumentParser.java,v 1.6 2010-11-01 04:40:10 joehw Exp $
    作者:
    Arnaud Le Hors, IBM, Andy Clark, IBM
